host: NIMBI - Danish Institute for Game Development
summary: Grants for activities advancing Danish digital games and the broader games industry. Supports spreading awareness of Danish games, promoting professional dialogue, and initiatives enhancing game quality and cultural impact. Funding covers a range of formats including events, publications, and promotional activities aimed at elevating the Danish game development scene.
eligible_applicants: Creative projects related to Danish digital games
activity_types: Awareness campaigns for Danish games domestically and internationally
Promotional initiatives for Danish children's games
Publications and research on Danish digital games
Projects improving quality and reach of Danish digital games
reporting_requirements: Applicants must document the use of funds and report on the outcomes of their funded activities as required by NIMBI.
